definitions.explanation: An expression of welcome said to someone who has come or arrived, equivalent to English 'welcome.'

examples.japanese: ようこそ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧。
ようこそ⟦{我|わ}が{家|や}→我が家：03038_wagaya⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧。

⟦{店長|てんちょう}→店長：30461_tenchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「ようこそ⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦くださいました→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{深々|ふかぶか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: The manager bowed deeply and said, 'Welcome, thank you for coming.'

notes:
An expression of welcome to a visitor or guest, frequently followed by a destination with ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: ようこそ〜⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧ ('welcome to ~').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ようこそ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: welcome to Japan
- ようこそ⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦くださいました→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧: welcome, thank you for coming (polite)
- ようこそ⟦いらっしゃいました→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧: welcome (polite)

USAGE:
Warmer and more personal than the routine shop greeting ⟦いらっしゃいませ→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧, which is called out to any customer entering a store.
